newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Petrol to be listed on bourse in May.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Petrol to be listed on bourse in May.

text.p: The Slovenian bourse said on Tuesday petrol trader Petrol would be listed on the main market of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on May 5.
Petrol, one of the country's five largest firms, will list 1.7 million ordinary shares with a nominal value of 6,000 tolars ($38.6) each, representing 80.34 percent of the company's equity.
The company was privatised in December, but the state still owns a 15.63 percent stake.
Petrol shares are currently traded at about 18,500 tolars on the grey market.
